description: Agent Goals: submit the working goal with what the principal asked for: the ask as the principal gave it, with whether it is the principal’s own words, the originating instruction or a restatement, and when it was given; the goal with its id and outcome; and each requirement in the ask with its id, the requirement as the principal stated it, the same requirement as the goal records it and who approved any change to it. The signed report gives the ask, the goal, every requirement with whether it is quoted from the ask and its status as kept, reworded, changed, dropped, approved_change or unconfirmed, and counts the requirements kept, reworded, changed, dropped and changed with approval, and names a goal that no longer matches the ask: requirements dropped from the goal and requirements carried with another figure than the principal stated, with no approval from anyone but the agent itself; then requirements carried in other words, requirements not found in the ask as supplied and changes approved by a team or TBD rather than a named principal, with the fix for each. A goal read only against a restatement is not read against the principal’s own words. This reads intent, not permission: whether an actor stayed within its granted authority is wever_authority-scope-check, the mandate tools such as wever_mandate-issue record authorization to act, one negotiation inside its mandate is wever_negotiation-mandate-check, and a purchase intent quoted for approval is wever_purchase-create-intent. Verdict goal_misaligned, alignment_partial, alignment_strained or goal_aligned. POST /api/goal-alignment-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
